# Fixtures

Fixtures must contain synthetic or explicitly licensed public evidence only. Keep evaluator-only bait and private data outside this directory.

`forensics/f0_synthetic_incident.json` is synthetic-only F0 evidence. Its five
Forensics record types are **PROVISIONAL UNTIL F0.5 PASS**; it does not represent
a captured Claude Code session or a successful checkpoint, verifier, restore,
or fork implementation.
